telemetry: Searched qwen_tts for analytics/telemetry/posthog/sentry: only demo.py (gradio UI, never imported by the adapter) matches 'gradio'. urllib.request.urlopen exists in qwen3_tts_model.py and qwen3_tts_tokenizer.py only to fetch a ref_audio given as a URL; the adapter passes arrays and local files. No other run-time fetch beyond HF model files. HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 set in the adapter; HF_TOKEN removed. No trust_remote_code. The 3 Qwen3 weights files are safetensors, no pickle loaded (torch.load with weights_only=True only in demo.py, unused). Network I/O during runs was not packet-captured.
problems: Speed: on the card the Base 0.6B clone path ran at RTF 1.66-1.96 (slower than real time) with 3 GB peak and GPU utilisation near idle between runs; likely launch/python-bound token loop in the HF generate path without flash-attn, on Windows; not investigated or tuned. CPU 4 threads float32 RTF about 3.06, i.e. only about 1.7x slower than the card.
No audio streaming in qwen-tts 0.1.1 (non_streaming_mode only simulates streamed text input), so no first-audio figure; the 97 ms claim of the paper is not reproducible with this package.
Every line starts with 0.24-0.79 s of near silence (first sample above 0.01); output is untrimmed as the contract requires.
Importing sox prints 'SoX could not be found' on every run (the python sox package; the 25 Hz tokenizer path only, not used here); harmless in these runs.
snapshot_download failed once with a Windows symlink error (WinError 1314) on the second repo with parallel workers; retried with max_workers=1 and it worked.
max_new_tokens capped at 600 (cast) and 1000 (lines) as a safety net instead of the package default 8192; no line hit the cap (longest 12.88 s = about 161 frames).
common.parse_args has no option for the cast device, so the adapter strips an extra --cast-device option from argv before calling it; VoiceDesign fitted the card, so the CPU fallback was not needed.
notVerified: Whether any voice sounds right or stays the same voice from line to line (nobody can hear; score.py was not run).
